meta.description: Knowledge graph for the ManiSkill PushT task: a Franka Panda with a panda_stick end-effector (no gripper, 7 arm joints) pushes a T-shaped block across a table to a fixed goal T-pose. Consumed by the P4-LLM reasoning + configuration components to ground failure analysis and the prescribed correction config. Workspace coordinates are world-frame metres; the PPO expert is reliable only inside the stated tee/tcp ranges.
meta.control_mode: pd_joint_pos (policy acts in rel_joint_pos = 7 joint deltas)

properties.approach_matters: must contact the correct T face to push toward the goal

properties.metric: intersection of movable T and goal T above threshold

properties.description: TCP contacts the wrong face/side of the T, pushing it away from the goal.
TCP pushes the T past the goal pose; momentum carries it through.
TCP never establishes contact with the T (approaches the wrong location or stalls).
T's z-rotation is not aligned with the goal; pushing translates but does not rotate it correctly.
Episode reaches the step horizon without success (hesitation / oscillation / slow approach).
establish contact on the correct face
translate the T toward the goal
fine z-rotation/position alignment with the goal T

reasoning_implications.wrong_approach: Prescribe a correction config whose tee start pose forces the policy to approach from the correct face: place the T so the demonstrated push direction toward the fixed goal is unambiguous, and set the tcp start on the push side.
reasoning_implications.overshoot: Prescribe a config with the T closer to the goal (shorter push) so the demo teaches a controlled, shorter approach that stops at the goal rather than driving through it.
reasoning_implications.no_contact: Prescribe a config with the tcp start adjacent to the T's push face so the demo emphasises contact establishment before pushing.
reasoning_implications.wrong_orientation: Prescribe a config whose tee z-rotation differs from the goal so the demo teaches the rotate-while-pushing behaviour needed to align orientation.
reasoning_implications.timeout: Prescribe a config that commits to a single direct push corridor toward the goal (no oscillation), with tee/tcp poses well inside the reliable workspace.
reasoning_implications.workspace_constraint: Every prescribed config MUST keep tee_xyz within x[-0.20,0.20] y[-0.25,0.05] z=0.021 and tcp_xyz within x[-0.35,0.35] y[-0.35,0.35] z[0.02,0.08]; out-of-range poses are dropped (the PPO expert is unreliable there) and waste the round.
reasoning_implications.non_emptiness: A failure is present, so the prescription MUST be a concrete, fully-specified config (non-empty tee_xyz, tee_zrot, tcp_xyz). Never emit an empty prescription — that collects zero demos and wastes the round.
